name: Form Process Quality Control (Web)
implementation_notes: The Process Quality Control Detail grid is fully dynamic -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() on FormProcessQualityControl.php, exactly mirroring FormClarification's grid. Grid starts empty on create mode; edit mode loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 16 non-time_slot columns per row are genuinely editable, never disabled -- Process Quality Control has no computed detail-grid fields and NO enum dropdowns at all: 12 are numeric inputs, 4 (Shift, QC Inspector ID, QC Engineering Corrective Actions, Findings) are plain text inputs -- the widest form grid in the project (min-width: 2600px)
UNLIKE Form Threshing Web: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind
Route /data/process-quality-control/create registered BEFORE /data/process-quality-control/{id} (screen-110) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormClarification's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By)
NoActiveProcessQualityControlStationException (mirrors NoActiveClarificationStationException) thrown when production_line_id has no active station type=process-quality-control

This is the FINAL screen of the FINAL (10th) station implemented in this project -- all 10 stations from the 2026-08-31 batch (Solid Waste Disposal, Process Water, Kernel Dispatch, CPO Dispatch, Effluent Plant, Storage Tank, Engine Room, Boiler Room, Clarification, Process Quality Control) are now fully implemented end-to-end (mobile + web) with all Data Browser tiles routed on Production Process Activity

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): ProcessQualityControlRecordService::create() memanggil assertPeriodOpenForWrite('process-quality-control', station->business_unit_id, date) setelah validasi & resolve station dan sebelum penulisan pertama; update() memanggilnya dua kali (tanggal lama record dan tanggal baru dari body) setelah findOrFail/cek akses/validasi — jadi memindahkan record keluar dari periode tertutup juga ditolak. Penolakan = PeriodClosedException 422 PERIOD_CLOSED dengan salah satu dari 4 pesan (belum ada periode / masih Draft / sudah ditutup / di luar rentang + rentang yang berlaku), nol baris tersimpan. FormProcessQualityControl::save() menangkap HttpException dan menampilkan pesannya sebagai alert halaman ($generalError). Test yang menutupnya: tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan + cek statis ke-18 service) dan tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php (end-to-end via Sterilizer); test per-layar (tests/Unit/Services/ProcessQualityControlRecordServiceTest.php, tests/Feature/Api/FormProcessQualityControlTest.php, tests/Feature/Livewire/FormProcessQualityControlTest.php) membuka periode Terbuka sebagai prasyarat via openPeriodFor()/openPeriodForStation(). test_results tidak diubah (suite tidak dijalankan ulang untuk sinkronisasi ini).

REVISI v3 (2026-10-03, uji ditambahkan — kode produksi tidak diubah): tests/Feature/Api/FormProcessQualityControlTest.php kini punya 3 uji HTTP kunci periode per-stasiun yang menutup celah 'penolakan kunci periode hanya diuji end-to-end via Sterilizer': (1) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat POST bertanggal di periode tertutup, tanpa menyimpan satu baris pun'; (2) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat PATCH record yang tanggal lamanya di periode tertutup walau tanggal barunya di periode terbuka, dan record tidak berubah'; (3) 'kunci periode: menerima 201 saat POST tepat pada tanggal awal dan tanggal akhir periode terbuka (inklusif)'. Ketiganya mengganti periode prasyarat dengan sepasang periode tertutup + terbuka lewat helper replacePrerequisiteWithClosedAndOpenPeriods() di tests/Pest.php. Berkas kini 19 uji, semuanya hijau (test_results.integration diperbarui).
